Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1961788. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary, then INNER JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter: standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000 rows.
